title: Cosmetologist Secrets, Mom Fails, Real Estate Wins & TV Shows | Working Moms Podcast Ep. 5
description:
Cosmetologist Secrets, Mom Fails, Real Estate Wins & TV Shows | Marisa Barrett & Gloria Watson

Welcome back to Working Moms! In this fun and informative Beauty Edition episode, Gloria turns the spotlight on co-host Marisa Barrett — a licensed cosmetologist with over 20 years of experience — to spill the secrets behind everyday haircare and beauty tips for busy women.

From how often you should really wash your hair to the truth about dry shampoo, scalp care, and blow-drying tools, this episode is packed with practical advice and relatable laughs. Plus, we dive into:

✔️ Hair myths debunked
✔️ Affordable vs luxury products — what really works
✔️ Marisa’s favorite hot tools and products
✔️ Real estate investing vs gold: what’s smarter in 2025
✔️ Our guilty pleasure TV shows and binge-watch faves
✔️ Weekly mom wins, fails, and blended family life

Whether you're a working mom, beauty lover, or real estate boss — you’ll love this honest, hilarious conversation.
